limits: Disposable fixtures concatenate actual wake acceptance and effect regions with their original main consciousness check.
Candidate fixtures include the marked real local templates and non-main dispatchers.
Only diagnostic dynamic definitions add counters; original effects and growth functions execute in the native engine.
No wake scene is added; no AP cost is introduced by tests or expected product behavior.
64 room repetitions detect fixed selection, not statistical uniformity.
Primed save assignments are used; actual save loading and GUI layout are not exercised.
